card.title: Help
card.body: Replay the walkthrough of the main places in Life OS.

welcome.title: Welcome to Life OS
welcome.body: Tasks, calendar, habits and goals in one place. Here's a quick look around; it takes about a minute.

quickAdd.title: Add anything
quickAdd.body: Tap + to capture a task, event, habit or note from any page. Sorting can wait.

home.title: Home
home.body: Your day at a glance: what's due, today's habits and the daily seal. Customize which sections show.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.body: Everything you need to do, by Today, Upcoming and Someday. Open a task for subtasks, tags and goals.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.body: Drag tasks onto your week, or let the app suggest a free time that fits.

plan.title: Plan
plan.body: Order today's work in the morning, and do a short weekly review on Sundays.

habits.title: Habits
habits.body: Check in each day. Streaks grow, and rest days keep one missed day from breaking them.

focus.title: Focus
focus.body: Tomato timers for deep work. Stuck? Start with just two minutes.

insights.title: Insights
insights.body: Your Life Balance Score and the trends behind it.

help.title: Want to see this again?
help.body: Tap Help any time to replay this tour. You'll also find it in Settings.
